name: BOM Template Export
description: Exports a bill of materials as Markdown or CSV, with the columns you define in a template such as "Qty={qty}, Designators={refs}, Value={value}, MPN={param:MPN}".

settings.title: Columns
settings.description: Comma-separated Title={field} entries. Fields: qty, refs, value, footprint, name, category, prefix and param:<Name>. Text around a field is kept, e.g. Part={value} ({param:Tolerance}).

settings.title: One line per
settings.description: Fields that must match for parts to share a line.

settings.title: Read parts from
settings.description: Auto uses the active document, or the schematic when neither kind is active.
